scientific_integrity: The first-passage density and moving-window convolution are classical. Claims of mathematical contribution are limited to the peak-lag uniqueness, sensitivity and sharp drift–diffusion crossover; direct independent validation and historical priority are not asserted.
scientific_limitations: Homogeneous one-dimensional absorbing drift–diffusion with finite constant input only; resident concentrations, source-boundary step models and reactive transport have different kernels. Historical full text for directly relevant older sources was inaccessible, leaving potential implication risk.
title: A drift–diffusion crossover in the peak lag after finite tracer shutoff
